page.layout: One printed page. Running head "INDEX GENERALIS" at the top centre. Then the heading "LOCUS XIV." and "DE DECALOGO.", followed by a two-column table of contents: roman numerals at left, titles in the centre with a brace "De", and page references at right. Then "LOCUS XV." and "DE LEGE RITUALI MOSIS." with a second table in the same layout. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the right margin and is left out.
